dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature fitting a spline from the posterior dorsal insertion point up to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is characterized by a broadly rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius, lacking any acute vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge follows a nearly linear trajectory ascending at approximately a 50-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin's maximum basal width is approximately 1.4 times its vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular white punctate markings are visible across the dark epidermis; no significant nicks, notches, or structural amputations are present on the fin margins.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of white speckling across the visible dark gray epidermal surface of the flank and dorsal fin.
